units.text: INT. COURTROOM 4B - SPLIT-LEVEL ANNEX - DAY
Wood panelling, fluorescent hum.
A cracked window shows a parking structure.
The room is packed and silent.
JUDGE EDITH WHITLOCK (60s, silver bob, half-moon glasses) presides.
At the plaintiff's table, ATTORNEY MARCUS DELANEY (40s, three-piece suit) shuffles notes beside his client, ROSALIND PEARCE (50s, nurse's cardigan, wedding ring she keeps turning).
At the defence table, ATTORNEY FELIX OYELOWO (30s, immaculate) sits beside his client, DR. NATHANIEL STROUD (60s, surgeon, bow tie).
In the box, a nervous BAILIFF HUGO (30s, uniform too big) stands at attention.
Counsel, approach.
units.name: JUDGE WHITLOCK

units.text: Delaney and Oyelowo rise together, stride to the bench.
She leans down, eyes narrowing.
I will not have another outburst. Is that clear?
units.name: JUDGE WHITLOCK

units.text: Perfectly, Your Honour.
units.name: DELANEY

units.text: Perfectly, Your Honour.
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: She sits back.
They return to their tables.
Delaney drops a folder in front of Rosalind, who squares it with both hands.
Stroud leans toward Oyelowo and whispers; Oyelowo shakes his head and stares straight ahead.
Mrs. Pearce, tell the court what you saw in the operating room.
units.name: DELANEY

units.text: I saw the anaesthesia log. It was blank.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Objection. Foundation.
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: Overruled. Continue.
units.name: JUDGE WHITLOCK

units.text: It was blank for forty minutes.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: And who was responsible for completing that log?
units.name: DELANEY

units.text: Dr. Stroud.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: A murmur from the gallery.
Stroud's jaw tightens.
He lifts a pen, sets it down, lifts it again.
Hugo shifts his weight and clears his throat.
Mrs. Pearce, you were the circulating nurse that day?
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: I was.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: And the log was your responsibility as well.
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: It was not.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: You're sure.
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: I've worked in that theatre for twenty-two years. I'm sure.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Oyelowo studies her.
She holds his gaze.
Delaney leans back, folding his hands, a small smile at the corner of his mouth.
Mr. Oyelowo, do you have a question?
units.name: JUDGE WHITLOCK

units.text: Several, Your Honour. But I'll start with one.
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: He turns, crosses to the box, stands very close.
Why did you wait eleven months to report it?
units.name: OYELOWO

units.text: Because no one asked.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Silence.
Stroud finally looks up.
For the first time, he looks at her.
